description:
A lovely, modern studio apartment, situated in the popular residential area of Ferryhill.
This apartment is well presented with a generous lounge/bedroom. Fitted with a double cabinet, fold-down bed. Which can be stored away descreetly when not in use. 

The kitchen is fitted with a selection of base and overhead units, which are in great condition. 
Appliances included:
Fridge
Freezer
Washing machine
Electric cooker
Electric hob

The bathroom has a white three piece suite. consisting of a pedestal wash-hand basin, toilet and bath with an overhead shower. 

The apartment has excellent storage solutions with two large walk in cupboards. Benefitting from double glazing and GCH. The building is factored at a cost of £28 p.c.m

Location
Ferryhill is a lovely area, situated in the heart of Aberdeen. Excellently placed for the Duthie park, riverside walks and access to the old railway line for keen cyclists or walkers. The city centre is a fifteen minute walk from the apartment, where there are a good selection of shops and amenities. Public transport is accessible nearby too, with buses running to RGU and Aberdeen University.

Council Tax Band: A (Aberdeen City Council)
Tenure: Freehold
